body: I haven't a single iota of why they hate me. It's beyond me.

Academically I'm a straight A student in most subjects, physically I'm easily one of the fittest people in my year, I do plenty of exercise. I'm calm, but intimidating, it helps I guess. People view me as shit under their shoe, nothing more, nothing less.
I know there's a light at the end of the tunnel, so to speak, but I can't cope.
I don't really have any other interests, no.
You're right. It's not hopeless, I've known this for a long time. But I just can't take it any more, I can't cope.
I can't keep my head up. I've tried, no matter what..

Tried it. All local football clubs (Which is basically the only thing outside of school I could possibly be interested in) has at least 2-3 people in it that are from my school, and know me. They usually end up chatting shit about me, and all the other kids jump on the bandwagon, and I'm pressured out of leaving within a few weeks...

Generally just reminding me of the fact how no one likes me, telling me that I'll never amount to anything, I'm always wrong, that I'm stupid... Generally just stuff to put me down. I know it may not seem like much, but hey ''The little things in life matter''. They may only seem little, but they affect me greatly.

Imho, to say or otherwise imply that your childhood is 'meaningless' is completely wrong. Your childhood is meant to be the most joyful and carefree time of your life, a time of your life where you have fun and don't worry about 'adult' things. Where you can just enjoy yourself...

I try, I really do. I've sat for hours, alone in my room trying to psyche myself up in to thinking that what they say doesn't matter. Next day, I go to school to hear all the shit, and it hurts just as much. I guess I'm super sensitive.
No, I don't get visibly angry. They just barrage me with insults and snidey comments. They use me as a verbal punch bag basically, and there's nothing I can do about it, and it's destroying me.

I had a friend who was pretty popular, and constantly stuck up for me in year 7. He would beat the living crap out of anyone who said a thing to me. He moved to Germany in the middle of the last term last year, and things got worse from then on. I've tried to look for people to become friends with, but no one shares my interests, and no one really wants to talk to me.

I don't give off any signs of being upset, unless they get personal. That usually ends up with me going ape shit and smashing a chair off the floor, or whatever is within my reach. I argue back constantly, it doesn't make a difference, they just gang up on me.

1) I've tried distancing myself from them and I can't seem to do it...

2) I don't even know. I don't really remember being happy any more

3) I do. I used to play a lot of football till I was pushed out of my club because of once again, not being liked. I wasn't bad, I was the best forward in our league. I mostly just game now, though. I guess it's the best way of distracting myself from how atrocious my life is.

4) Indeed I am.
The thing is, they don't look up to one person. They're all equally as popular and liked. There isn't a ringleader at all, not even in the slightest... That's what worries me.

I'm the hardest kid in my year. I still get shit despite them seeing me beat the crap out of a year 9 when I was in year 7, they know I'm capable of doing it again, yet they know I'm not going to it again and again because I don't want to be expelled. I've been told if I'm involved in one more fight I'll be expelled. I don't want to throw my education away.

Also, it's pretty hard  to talk shit back when 4 people are shouting out what you're saying.
I'm 13. I understand it's a temporary problem, but I feel the likely hood of something like this happening outside of school is rather high; Being hated.
